query: SELECT filename, COUNT(*) as cnt FROM documents WHERE "projectId" = (SELECT id FROM projects WHERE name LIKE '%Behna%' LIMIT 1) GROUP BY filename HAVING COUNT(*) > 1 ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 15;
